title: Issue #3777 delivery
intent:
事象: agent が `execution.blocked` で実行不能を宣言しました。
原因: Implementation, tests and PR delivery for #3777 are complete. Head 0844eee7d has origin/develop merged and pushed, worktree clean, nothing unpushed, .codex/hooks.json identical to develop. CI on the prior heads was green on every job that matters: Linux Test (Rust) SUCCESS (the job red all session) and 16 checks SUCCESS on 6c7e7bd94. PR #4218 carries User Verification Result: confirmed and the Ready decision is handed to the PM on the Board. What is blocked is only the local verification record. verify.run was called five times with inline params.commands and verify.lease.acquire was never used, per the PM instruction; every call deferred at the full budget. The verification lease is not a queue advancing but a succession of long-lived holders: attempts 1-4 hit 3d500b80d5d2bcd6 (pid 12396) which reported 0s left without ever lapsing, and attempt 5 hit a fresh holder 8d8c24a7d3c70466 (pid 32612) with 2421s left. params.wait_seconds is ignored and the budget stays clamped at 300s. This is fleet-wide, not local: #4172, #4231, #4229, #4206, #3697 and #4210 are queued behind the same lease ids, #3697 reports six consecutive full-budget deferrals over about 2h40m without once reaching a compile, and #4210 handed Ready back without a record for the same reason. Escalation 75b046ba-ea2c-4fe6-b566-be338d029237 is open and mirrored to #3777 as comment 5621737614. I am not settling complete because the owner requires a verification record I cannot mint, and I am not using execution.complete followed by execution.continue because #3697 showed that path revokes verify authority and mints a stranded successor generation on an Issue with no new work.
未実施の検証: gwt-verify pre-pr record for head 0844eee7d. Blocked solely by verification lease starvation from rotating holders (3d500b80d5d2bcd6 pid 12396, then 8d8c24a7d3c70466 pid 32612), not by any known defect. Also note workspace.update was refused on every attempt this cycle with 409 execution_binding_mismatch (the execution.adopt host bridge desync), so the #3777 Work ledger is stale while Board and PR are accurate.
依頼: 上記の blocker を解消してください（fresh launch / 仕様裁定 / ツール修正 のいずれかを判断してください）。
再開条件: blocker が解消され、この Issue の残作業を実行できる状態になること。

この投稿は gwt が自動起票しました（Issue #3655 AC-1）。担当 agent は判明している調査結果を補足してください。
